gloss: that guy; that thing; that one (rough)

definitions.explanation: a rough, informal way to refer to a person near the listener or previously mentioned; can be dismissive or contemptuous depending on context

definitions.gloss: that thing; that one (object or matter)
definitions.explanation: an informal way to refer to an object, idea, or matter near the listener or previously mentioned

examples.japanese: そいつ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{誰|だれ}→誰：00534_dare⟧だ？
そいつ、⟦{取|と}って→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦くれ→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
そいつ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{関|かか}わる→関わる：03020_kakawaru⟧な。
examples.english: Don't get involved with that guy.

examples.japanese: そいつ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{面白|おもしろ}そうだ。
そいつ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧こと⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{信用|しんよう}できない→信用する：25371_shinyousuru⟧。
examples.english: You can't trust what that guy says.

examples.japanese: そいつ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{良|い}い⟦{考|かんが}え→考え：00855_kangae⟧だ。

notes:
REGISTER:
The rough equivalent of ⟦それ→それ：00994_sore⟧ (that) and ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ (that person). Said of a person, it is very casual and often dismissive or rude; avoid it in polite conversation and use ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ or ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧ instead. Said of a thing or a situation, it is just casual (そいつ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{良|よ}かった→良い：02350_yoi⟧, that's great).

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦こいつ→こいつ：08268_koitsu⟧: this guy / this thing
- ⟦あいつ→あいつ：08267_aitsu⟧: that guy (over there, or known to both)
- どいつ: which guy

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- そいつ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大変|たいへん}→大変：00594_taihen⟧だ: that's tough
- そいつ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{良|よ}かった→良い：02350_yoi⟧: that's great
